title.zh: 将北甘马粦省帕拉卡莱市镇马拉吉特描笼涯Malaguit小学的名称变更为Pedro V. Moreno小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Malaguit Elementary School in Barangay Malaguit, Municipality of Paracale, Province of Camarines Norte, To Pedro V. Moreno Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Malaguit Elementary School in Barangay Malaguit, Municipality of Paracale, Province of Camarines Norte, To Pedro V. Moreno Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Malaguit tại Barangay Malaguit, Thị trấn Paracale, Tỉnh Camarines Norte thành Trường tiểu học Pedro V. Moreno
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Malaguit ในบารังไกย์ Malaguit, เทศบาล Paracale, จังหวัด Camarines Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pedro V. Moreno
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Malaguit di Barangay Malaguit, Kotamadya Paracale, Provinsi Camarines Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Pedro V. Moreno
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Malaguit di Barangay Malaguit, Perbandaran Paracale, Wilayah Camarines Norte menjadi Sekolah Rendah Pedro V. Moreno

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7603_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Malaguit Elementary School in Barangay Malaguit, Municipality of Paracale, Province of Camarines Norte, is hereby changed to Pedro V. Moreno Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
